note: Special-item rows of the forecast reconciliation are items already recorded through March 31, not forecasts, so excluded (as in the AEP dev label). 6%-8% EPS growth through 2029 is a long-term target, excluded. $5.1 billion 2026 infrastructure investments included as capex.

facts.evidence: Based on the company’s financial performance year to date, PPL reaffirmed its 2026 ongoing earnings forecast range of $1.90 to $1.98 per share with a midpoint of $1.94 per share.

“We’re on pace to complete $5.1 billion in 2026 infrastructure investments to strengthen and modernize our electric and gas networks, build new generation resources in Kentucky and improve customer service while maintaining affordability for our customers.”
